# Crosshatch

Redraws the image in pen-and-ink hatching: darker areas get more layers of crossing lines.

<EffectDemo effect="crosshatch" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { crosshatch } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/crosshatch';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(crosshatch({ preset: 'etching' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.spacing = 6`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                                                          | Default     | Range      | Description                                           |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `spacing`  | number                                                        | `6`         | 2 – 24 px  | Distance between lines.                               |
| `angle`    | number                                                        | `45`        | 0 – 180 °  | Angle of the first layer of lines.                    |
| `darkness` | number                                                        | `0`         | -0.5 – 0.5 | Shifts where layers start: positive draws more lines. |
| `ink`      | hex color (theme: [`text`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles))       | `'#1b1b22'` |            | Line color.                                           |
| `paper`    | hex color (theme: [`background`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#f4efe4'` |            | Paper color.                                          |
| `colored`  | boolean                                                       | `false`     |            | Draw lines in a dark version of the image’s colors.   |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                             |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `etching`   | `spacing: 4`, `darkness: 0.2`        |
| `loose`     | `spacing: 10`, `angle: 30`           |
| `colored`   | `colored: true`, `spacing: 5`        |
| `blueprint` | `ink: '#e8f0ff'`, `paper: '#123a73'` |

Apply one with `crosshatch({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Stylization · tracked as story X8.7 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 7.2 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/crosshatch`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Luminance-thresholded hatching layers, after tonal art maps (Praun et al., 2001).
